accepted.hypothesis: Injecting 500ms network delay on service/front-end will cause the front-end home page to exceed the 15s timeout, violating the non-empty HTML contract.

accepted.validation_plan: Inject network_delay on service/front-end, then execute front-end home step and measure response time and status.
accepted.recovery_expectation: Removing the delay restores normal response times and contract compliance.
accepted.weakness_surface: front-end is the entry point for all golden journey steps; delay directly impacts response time.
